response.overview: A socially avoidant research analyst at a condom company secretly longs for real-world intimacy, but remains trapped behind his own paralyzing self-loathing. When a vibrant new coworker enters his life and awakens his desire to connect, his deep-seated anxieties cause him to hesitate until the opportunity slips away. Heartbroken by the missed chance, he finally gets the jolt he needs to confront his fear and begin transforming his life.
response.title: Protected
